title: The Moth in the Harvest Quilt
description: At the harvest quilting festival, a patchwork moth pulls free of the stitches. Through the opening in the quilt, the quilters see the sunlit fields.
alt: Two quilters hold golden spools as a giant patchwork moth lifts from a quilt in a barn, revealing autumn fields through a wing-shaped opening.
pairing: An imagined harvest quilting festival × a moth sewn from patchwork
